subject: Civic Education
competence: Contributes to minimizing road accidents by following road rules.
unique_learning_outcome: Presents information about road accidents and disasters caused at present.
Shows with example the preventive measures for accidents.
Explains road rules using signs and signals.
Shows the measures to be followed avoid railway accidents.
Explains how to react at a road or railway accident.
the_entrance: Imagine you are driving on a busy highway and suddenly, a car in front of you stops abruptly. What would you do?

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Introduce the concept of road accidents and their causes.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will brainstorm and share their thoughts on what causes road accidents.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Show examples of preventive measures for road accidents.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will work in groups to brainstorm and present their ideas on preventive measures.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitor group progress and provide feedback.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Summarize the key findings and explain road rules using signs and signals.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will present their group findings and explain road rules.

summary: Recap of key findings: Road accidents can be prevented by following road rules and taking preventive measures.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Summative check: Students will complete a quiz on road rules and preventive measures.
post_activity: Homework: Students will research and write a short essay on the causes and preventive measures of road accidents.
information_sources: National Institute of Education (NIE) Teacher Instructional Guide
